project.name: Hitchwiki Maps
project.description: Community hitchhiking map that aggregates rides, official hitchhiking spots, car-pooling spots and gas stations.

tags.description: Official designated hitchhiking spots are imported from OSM and shown as markers on the map; user-submitted rides within 100 m are linked to them.
Car-pooling / ride-sharing meeting points are imported from OSM and surfaced as nearby car-pooling spots on the map.
Gas stations near hitchhiking spots are read from OSM to flag spots that sit at a fuel station (a good place to ask drivers for a ride).
